data.one_liner: Validate, format, strip and generate Brazilian CPF and CNPJ numbers.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility classes to validate, format, strip, and generate Brazilian CPF and CNPJ identification numbers. It supports both raw and formatted string inputs with customizable stripping behavior.
use_when: You need to validate user input for Brazilian CPF or CNPJ documents in forms.
You need to format raw CPF/CNPJ strings or strip formatting characters.
You need to generate random valid CPF or CNPJ numbers for testing or placeholders.
avoid_when: Your application does not deal with Brazilian tax or identification numbers.
strengths: Simple and straightforward static API methods.
Supports both validation and generation of CPF and CNPJ.
weaknesses: Limited in scope strictly to Brazilian CPF/CNPJ numbers.
No built-in UI form field widgets provided out of the box.
